sn35.103:1.1: sudam bhikkhave Rāmaputto evaṃ vācam bhāsati || ||
sn35.103:1.6: Taṃ kho panetam bhikkhave Uddako Rāmaputto avedagū yeva samāno Vedagusmīti bhāsati || asabbajī yeva samāno Sabbajismīti bhāsati || apalikhitaṃ yeva gaṇḍamūlam palikhitam me gaṇḍamūlan ti bhāsati || || 3
sn35.103:1.7: Idha kho tam bhikkhave bhikkhu sammā vadamāno vadeyya || ||
sn35.103:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu vedagū hoti || ||
sn35.103:2.2: Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu channam phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca assādañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam pajānāti ||
sn35.103:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vedagū hoti || || 5
sn35.103:3.2: Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu channam phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti ||
sn35.103:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaji hoti || || 6
sn35.103:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu apalikhitaṃ gaṇḍamūlam palikhitaṃ hoti || ||
sn35.103:4.2: Gaṇḍo ti kho bhikkhave imassetaṃ cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsupacayassa aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammassa || ||
sn35.103:4.4: Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti || ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatim anuppādadhammā ||
sn35.103:4.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlam palikhitaṃ hoti || || 7
sn35.103:5.1: Uddako sudam bhikkhave Rāmaputto evaṃ vācam bhāsati || ||
sn35.103:5.6: Taṃ kho panetam bhikkhave Uddako Rāmaputto avedagū yeva samāno Vedagūsmīti bhāsati || asabbajī yeva samāno Sabbajīsmīti bhāsati || apalikhitaṃ yeva gaṇḍamūlam Palikhitam me gaṇḍamūlanti bhāsati || || 8
sn35.103:5.7: Idha kho tam bhikkhave bhikkhu sammāvadamāno vadeyya || ||
